name: Pygmalion ~The Dark Romance~
source:
Johann, a doll artist, lost his fiancee, Gulietta, due to illness. He is now extremely depressed and stays in his studio all day. In the studio, he secretly creates a doll... that resembles his deceased fiancee, Gulietta. However, the doll never heals his sorrow.... "I'll give anything if someone gives life to this doll!" A girl, Bell, suddenly appears in front of him and says, "I'll do it for you. However, you'll need to give me "the ties of friendship with your friends" in return." He has nothing to lose. He doesn't care what will happen to the world as long as Gulietta comes back.... Like this, a tragic rondo starts now.... 

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
人偶艺术家约翰因未婚妻朱丽叶塔病逝而悲痛欲绝，终日把自己关在工作室里。他在那里秘密制作了一具人偶……其模样与已故未婚妻朱丽叶塔一模一样。然而，人偶始终无法治愈他的哀伤……“只要有人能赋予这具人偶生命，我愿意付出一切！”一名叫贝尔的少女突然现身，对他说：“我可以替你实现。不过，你必须用“与朋友之间的羁绊”作为交换。”约翰已经一无所有。只要朱丽叶塔能够回来，他根本不在乎世界会变成什么样……就这样，一曲悲剧回旋曲拉开序幕……
